notes: Employees by region from the Sustainability Report 2025 (2024 column; the quoted rows also show 2022 and 2023). The Korea row is the only single-country figure; the other regions are Samsung's own groupings (Asia covers Southeast Asia, Southwest Asia, China and Japan) and no country list is given, so countries is null for them. Regional rows sum to the company total of 262,647; they exclude 59,693 non-Samsung Electronics workers reported separately. Samsung says it owns 240 manufacturing sites, sales offices, R&D centers and design centers in total, 33 of them manufacturing sites (Sustainability Report 2025), but no per-country site count. The Business Report names major production sites by product: smartphones at Gumi (plus Vietnam, India and Brazil) and memory at Hwaseong, Pyeongtaek and other Korean sites plus China. Sites come from the FY2024 Business Report (company-hosted English translation of the DART filing); the Taylor, Texas foundry is recorded only as the 2021 investment announcement the report describes. Taxes: Samsung publishes the regional split of taxes and public duties (2024: Korea 36.6%, Americas and Europe 40.7%, Asia 21.2%, others 1.5% of KRW 8.2 trillion); those tax regions are a different grouping from the employee regions and are listed as separate rows. No U.S. state data.
